title: KYC upload with FATCA/CRS (KRA)
when: Daily (new and changed clients); once for the legacy FATCA/CRS backlog
purpose: New accounts and changed KYC details for the KRA, with each client's FATCA/CRS self-certification after Ledgerline's own twelve columns. The legacy bulk file of clients onboarded before 1 August 2024 uses the same layout, as modifications.
linked: KYC & PMLA: the KRA upload file (and the nightly KRA upload job); FATCA / CRS: the legacy bulk file. Marking a file uploaded records each certification as at the KRA.
source: The first twelve columns are Ledgerline's generic KRA file. The FATCA/CRS columns after them are named as in KFintech KRA circular KARVY/OPS/INTERM/GENRL/24-07 of 11 June 2024 (the FATCA/CRS fields and their validations); CVL KRA communique CVL/OPS/INTERM/GENRL/24-200 of 28 June 2024 (FATCA/CRS with the KYC upload from 1 August 2024). The TIN exemption reason and issuing country, nationality, US person and the fields of SEBI HO/38/14/(18)2026-MIRSD-POD2/I/25560/2026 of 11 November 2026, paras 6.1-6.3 (validity indicator, controlling persons, account type and pre-existing or new) are not in a KRA format yet: Ledgerline's column names, to confirm with the KRA. Edit this layout to match your KRA's template.
